text: Good morning, City Museum. How can I help?
Good morning. What time do you open, please?
We open at ten, every day except Monday.
And what time do you close?
Five in the afternoon, but the last entry is at half past four.
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, please?
Of course. Last entry: four thirty. After that, no more people come in.
Thank you. Are you open on Sunday?
We are, but only until three. And how long is your visit? Most families take about two hours.
So: Tuesday, open at ten, last entry half past four, and two hours inside. Is that right?
Exactly right. Do you want to book for Tuesday?
Yes, please. Two adults and two children, Tuesday morning.
Booked. See you on Tuesday, and please arrive fifteen minutes early.
What time do you open, please?
Can I book for Tuesday morning, please?

Thank you for calling the City Museum. Please listen to this message, because it answers most questions. We are open from Tuesday to Sunday, from ten in the morning until five in the afternoon. On Sunday we close earlier, at three. We are closed all day on Monday, and we are also closed on the first of January and the twenty-fifth of December. The last entry is always thirty minutes before we close, so on a normal day that is half past four, and on Sunday it is half past two. A visit takes about two hours with children. If you come with a group of more than ten people, please call us in the morning, between nine and ten. To speak to a person, stay on the line. Thank you.

Hello, this is a message about your bus tour on Thursday. I am sorry, but we have to change the time. The tour was at half past two, and now it starts at four o'clock, because of the traffic in the centre in the afternoon. The tour is still one hour and twenty minutes, so you finish at twenty past five. The meeting point is the same, in the square. If four o'clock is not good for you, we have two other options: Thursday at ten in the morning, or Friday at the same time, half past two. Please call us before Wednesday evening and tell us what you prefer. If we do not hear from you, we keep you on Thursday at four. Thank you.
Good morning. What time do you open, please? And what time do you close? Are you open on Sunday? Can I book for Tuesday morning? Thank you very much.
The museum is closed on Mondays.
We are open until five in the afternoon.
What time do you open, please?
The tour is one hour and twenty minutes.
Can I book for Tuesday morning, please?
